curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach braking room ahead of trucks, easing off when a truck passes, keeping right past oncoming trucks, the three counted thousand trail, the dangers of tailing a truck, wide right turns, backing trucks, and the other truck hints on signals, ramps, rail crossings, lanes and shoulders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for truck braking power and right turn tail paths.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on trucks: trailing gaps, right turns, backing and passing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover entering at the speed of traffic from a ramp, the four second merge opening split two and two, keeping pace with traffic, holding speed until the exit ramp, and crossing only through openings that are fully clear.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the merge gap versus the following gap and for a green light at a blocked crossing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on ramps, merge openings, pace and crossing traffic.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach counting the three second gap from a fixed mark, the situations that stretch it to four seconds, guarding the space behind, handling tailgaters, keeping side room, avoiding blind spots, and slowing in trouble spots.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for three seconds versus four and for moving right versus brake checking a tailgater.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on following gaps, tailgaters, side room and trouble spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the mirror, shoulder and far lane checks before a lane change, one lane per move, passing one car at a time, the ten seconds and sixteen hundred feet a pass needs, returning when both headlights show in the mirror, where not to pass, and the keep right rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for pass length versus pass end and for the left lane versus the keep right law.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on lane changes, passing space and lane use.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach turning from the nearest lane into the nearest lane, tight right turns and roomy left turns, turning near bicycles, the ban on backing in travel lanes and its exceptions, and safe reversing steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for right versus left turn arcs and for the backing ban versus its exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on turn paths and backing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover using headlights when sight dims, the third of a mile of view, treating blind hills as oncoming cars, checking mirrors on downhills, road users who may not see you, and the habits never to allow while driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the sight rule versus the pass ban near blind hills.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sight distance, unseen road users and distractions.
